defs.def: a formal talk that a person gives to an audience 演说；讲话；发言

ex.s: Human speech contains more than 2,000 different sounds, from the common “m” and “a” to the rare clicks of some southern African languages.
ex.t: 人类的演讲包含2000多个不同的声音,从常见的“m”和“a”到一些南部非洲语言的罕见点击。

ex.s: A ground-breaking, five-year study shows that diet-related changes in human bite led to new speech sounds that are now found in half the world’s languages.
ex.t: 一项为期五年的突破性研究表明，与饮食相关的人类咬伤变化导致了新的语音，现在世界上有一半的语言都有这种语音。

ex.s: More than 30 years ago, the scholar Charles Hockett noted that speech sounds called labiodentals, such as “f” and “v”, were more common in the languages of societies that ate softer foods.
ex.t: 30多年前,学者查尔斯·霍克特(Charles Hockett)指出,在食用软食的社会语言中,称为labiodentals的语音,如“f”和“v”更为常见。

ex.s: This research overturns the popular view that all human speech sounds were present when human beings evolved around 300,000 years ago. ”The set of speech sounds we use has not necessarily remained stable since the appearance of human beings, but rather the huge variety of speech sounds that we find today is the product of a complex interplay of things like biological change and cultural evolution,“ said Steven Moran, a member of the research team.
ex.t: 这一研究推翻了流行的观点,即人类在30万年前进化时,所有人类的语音都存在。 “我们使用的一套语音自人类出现以来并不一定保持稳定,而我们今天发现的各种各样的语音是生物变化和文化进化等事物复杂相互作用的产物。

ex.s: "Big change requires big ideas." he said in a speech last month, referring broadly to the need to improve road safety.
ex.t: "大变革需要大思想"他在上个月的一次演讲中说,泛指改善道路安全的必要性.

ex.s: It’s better to leave your listeners wishing for more than shifting restlessly in their seats waiting for your speech finally to end.
ex.t: 最好不要让听众在座位上闲转,

ex.s: The objective of most speeches is to benefit the audience.
ex.t: 大多数演讲的目的是让观众受益.
